snippet.title: Ardenfall New Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Jump into Ardenfall's NEW Demo, now available on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1154960/Ardenfall/

This is a completely new demo with 100% new content! Explore the Suromi coast, defeat monsters with improved combat systems, and complete the main quest's 5 unique endings! This demo is around 2 hours per playthrough.

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/cWHusrm
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ardenfall
